entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • System.ObjectDisposedException in HttpClient Before Task.Delay Completes #50143
  • Reenable PublishingRegistersWrittenFilesForProperCleanup test once msbuild changes are unreverted again #50140
  • `_TransformWebConfig` target should not run if `IsPublishable` is `false` #50139

Closed

  • NUnit is no longer version 3 #45467
  • Ability to inject project/package reference from command line #49985
  • Revise dotnet test behavior if test app targets `netX.0;netX.0-windows` #49924
    10.0.1xx
  • [Razor] Emit embedded `ValidatableTypeAttribute` in the presence of .razor files #50082

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'main' #50144
  • [wasm] Don't call .NET runtime if browser refresh script for HotReload is missing #50138
    Area-AspNetCore, 10.0.1xx
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #50137
  • Implement global --config-file and --diagnostic-output-directory options for dotnet test MTP #50136
  • Add test for MTP test app with empty entry-point that doesn't handshake with dotnet test #50131

Merged

  • Remove NUnit version 3 references from template display names while preserving internal identities #50133
  • [Accessibility] Update the .NET logo #50116
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.3xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #50135
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'main' #50132
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #50101
  • TerminalTestReporter: Use executionId as dictionary key #50134
  • [Razor] Generate embedded ValidatableTypeAttribute inline during build for .razor files #50083
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.3xx' #50118
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'main' #50119

Updated

  • Use real SdkResolver APIs to set .NET environment variables for .NET TaskHost purposes #50091
  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Add support for CsWinRT 3.0 multi-targeting via Windows SDK build number #49721
    Area-Infrastructure
  • ensure that the run commands operates on minimal verbosity by default #50114
    Area-CLI, Area-Run
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50073
    Area-CodeFlow
  • Add better error messages for dotnet test with file/directory arguments in Microsoft Testing Platform (MTP) #50108
  • Cleanup TestProgressState #50056
    Area-dotnet test
  • Update xunit templates to xunit.v3 #50117
  • Remove unnecessary license and xml headers #49963
    Area-Infrastructure
